g.text: Configure an assignment and its grading mode [FR-1, FR-6]
IMMEDIATE grades during the submission run,
NIGHTLY defers to a triggered rerun. One
choice for the whole assignment, so a
submission is wholly one or the other.
Both live in the database, so changing either
needs no re-upload of the autograder zip.
Guidance for the instructor guide: IMMEDIATE
adds LLM latency inside the autograder
timeout, and submissions spike before a
deadline. Large courses should prefer NIGHTLY.
[for each method or class to grade]
feedback_mode is the instructor's control over

ALWAYS -- every submission, for style or
design feedback no test can detect.
NEVER -- targets graded purely by tests.
The target identifiers registered here are a
contract with her test suite.** She passes
these exact strings to record_outcome and
request_ai_feedback. Rename a target in the
web app and her suite stops matching, so the
UI should make renaming visibly consequential
and the API should reject unknown names

harder than before. In nightly mode an
approval gate is possible between PENDING and
the rerun. In immediate mode there is no
window: feedback reaches the student in the
